summary.text: Les Warren is serving his fifth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 84, which includes a portion of Garland County.

paragraphs.text: He is president of the Hot Springs Title Company, earned a master's degree from the University of Arkansas, and previously served on the school board of the Lakeside School District in Hot Springs.
He lives in Hot Springs with his wife, Pam.
